answer.reason: The verses tell of Baruch writing and reading Jeremiah's words, and of the burned roll he wrote again.

clauses.english: wrote Jeremiah's words on a roll and read them to the people in the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD

clauses.english: was sought by King Jehoiakim after the roll was burned, but the LORD hid him
wrote the words again on another roll after Jehoiakim burned the first
clauses.quote: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe

doubts: JER 32:12-16 (the deed of purchase given to Baruch) is left out as a minor detail, and the clause on reading the roll stands as a single event.
JER 43:3 and 43:6 (accused of inciting Jeremiah, taken to Egypt) are left out as accusations and journey stages; JER 45 only tells what the LORD said to him.
